name: Kurenai Tsuki
source:
Main character meets a red-eyed girl on a stormy night, and he is entrusted with a red wax stone that emits a sinister shine. But afterwards he forgets about this encounter.
But soon on a stormy day out of season a mysterious beautiful girl  transfers to school. She does not confirm or deny being the same girl giving the shiny stone.

At the same time abominable incidents and ominous events begin to occur one after another. And every time the incident happens, "Red Crimson" in the palm of protagonist starts to glow with evil red radiance...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在风雨交加的夜晚遇见了红眼少女，并被托付了一颗散发着凶恶光芒的红色蜡石。但后来他就忘记了这次遭遇。
但不久，在一个淡季的暴风雨天，一位神秘的美丽女孩转学到了学校。她没有确认或否认是给予闪亮宝石的同一个女孩。

与此同时，令人厌恶的事件和不祥的事件开始接二连三地发生。而每当事件发生时，主角掌心的“赤红”就会开始散发出邪恶的红色光芒……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
